description: Orange flavour, cherry flavour and grape flavour water ices Popsicle stick paint puzzle What you'll need: - Popsicle sticks - Tape - Paint Tip: Up the Challenge! Repeat on the back side with another image to create a 2nd puzzle Instructions 1 Wash and dry sticks before using them 2 Line up 6 Popsicle sticks in a row 3 Tape sticks together, then gently turn over 4 Paint your favorite Popsicle treat, an animal, a self-portrait or anything at all! Just make sure to completely cover all sticks with paint 5 Remove tape & shuffle Popsicle Orange, Cherry & Grape Ice Lollies are a classic combo in the colours of the rainbow. There’s a flavour for everyone in this box of deliciously refreshing water ices, with each ice lolly containing only 39 calories and no artificial colours. The perfect addition to any summer day, serve it at a party or just keep it in the freezer for an after-dinner dessert. The very first Popsicle water ice was created way back in 1905 by an 11-year-old named Frank Epperson. That’s right, Popsicle was invented by a kid! After a long day of play, Frank went inside but left a fizzy drink with a stirring stick on the veranda. The night got cold, and when Frank went outside the next morning, he found his drink frozen like an icicle. Frank called his invention the ‘Epsicle’. It was a hit with the kids at school, and later with his own kids who called it ‘Pop’s sicle’, and that’s where Popsicle came from. The name was catchy and the treat was delicious, so Frank patented it in 1923 to share his Popsicle ice lollies with the world.
